jobs.title: Seasonal Sales Associate 2026 -  Legacy Place
jobs.description_text: As a Tecovas Seasonal Sales Associate, you will support the store leadership team through the cultivation of a store environment catering to an unmatched customer experience. Seasonal Sales Associates are responsible for outstanding customer service and demonstrating superior knowledge to customers during periods of high volume. Key holiday events; including the week of Thanksgiving (including the Friday after Thanksgiving), the week of Christmas (including the day after Christmas), and the week between Christmas and New Years (including New Years Day). This is a temporary role with an expected start date in late-September 2026 and can last through early-January 2027. Opportunities to become a permanent Sales Associate may become available after the season, pending individual performance and business needs. Responsibilities will include : Supports a sales-driven environment of genuine customer experience and demonstrate extraordinary service standards Supports store team with receiving shipment and preparing product for floor placement Plans for, tracks and communicates all in transit shipment information to the leadership team Performs customizations for customers with hands-on training Maintains an efficient and well-organized stockroom ensuring accessibility to employees Assists in and/or leads the restock process to continually maintain store stock levels Demonstrates loss prevention awareness through assisting in cycle counts and transfers Participates in ongoing staff e

jobs.description_text: About the team Air Dominance & Strike designs, builds, and flies autonomous air vehicles — from collaborative combat aircraft to expendable cruise missiles to counter-UAS interceptors. Our vehicles move from whiteboard to first flight on timelines that traditional primes consider impossible, which means our design cycles live or die on how fast we can close the iteration loop and begin testing. The Anduril AI-Engineering team exists to collapse that loop. We are engineers first. We work from engineering first principles and unlock capability through machine learning. We are building to scale across design, analysis, test, and program execution, with agent pipelines and tooling that carry across programs. About the job We are looking for an Agentic AI Engineer to automate engineering workflows, build new capability through agents, and improve how engineers access and act on their data. Our R&D work runs through tools of varying fidelity, from empirical methods and low-order models to high-fidelity solvers. You will chain those tools into automated flows that carry a design through analysis to build and then back into the next iteration. You will own agent pipelines end to end: orchestration logic, tool and data integrations, evaluation harnesses, and guardrails. jobs.title: Discovery Engineer
jobs.location_raw: Washington, District of Columbia, United States · Costa Mesa, California, United States
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE TEAM Discovery is Anduril's team for the hard concepts: the ones that are not yet proven or built. We take the newest and hardest problems across space, missiles, air, sensors, autonomy, and cyber, decide what is worth building, and prove it out: we build the models, break the assumptions, run the tests, and carry what works to the point where a program can pick it up. We work with hardware and software engineering teams across the company, driving cross-functional collaboration across different business lines. ABOUT THE JOB We are building an expeditionary force: a small group of engineers who want to do big, new, hard things and who move into unfamiliar territory as a matter of course. As a Discovery Engineer you pick up a concept nobody has proven, learn whatever domain it lives in, build the analysis or prototype that tests it, and get to an answer. The problems change; the approach does not: reason from first principles, do the work, check it, and reach a solution. You are not hired for a particular skill set. You are hired for a record of getting engaged in problems across different areas, being analytic, testing new concepts, and getting to solutions. You are also the adversary to our own ideas. The rigor that validates a good concept is the same rigor that kills a bad one early, while it is still cheap, and you apply it to your own work first.
